Test molecules are used only for transforms fitted on the training data (clip bounds, standardisation, spline basis). There is no file access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. GroupKFold, rankdata and desc_features are not imported or defined in the diff, so they must already exist in the incumbent. The job completed and gave a score, which confirms this.

Small code-quality point: the final blend now hardcodes 0.45/0.35/0.20 and no longer uses W_DESC, which is now a dead setting. This also changes the desc:fp ratio from whatever W_DESC was, so two things change at once and the effect of the spline member alone can't be separated.

The numbers support the result. The candidate loss of 0.4826 is worse than the incumbent's 0.4774, a difference of +0.0052. Using a difference sd of sqrt(2)*0.0070 ≈ 0.0099, z ≈ -0.525 (negative means worse). This matches the harness value of -0.520 up to rounding. Rejecting is correct.
